name: Paper Beast: Enhanced Edition
storyline: Somewhere deep down in the vast memory of a data server, an ecosystem has emerged. Decades of lost code and forgotten algorithms have accumulated in the eddies and flows of the internet. A small bubble of life has blossomed. Paper Beast is born.
summary:
Embark on an extraordinary adventure and help a living world.

Paper Beast Enhanced Edition Improvements:
- Smooth locomotion.
- HDR image fine-tuned specifically for PS VR2, for vibrant colors and smooth nuances.
- 4K rendering.
- Detailed textures and high-resolution shadows.
- Light shaft effects.
- Extremely precise sand and water physics.
- Sandbox: The terrain is more expansive, with an increased number of creatures and trees that become even more stunning over time.
- Option of playing without a VR headset.
